title: lepidium montanum var. spathulatum
intro: Lepidium montanum var. spathulatum, commonly known as Mountain Pepper Cress, is a variant of the Lepidium montanum plant species, belonging to the mustard family (Brassicaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Pepper Cress include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant and mucolytic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates, glucosinolates, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
